premises.text: Hidden catches in free offerings destroy trust and block mainstream freemium adoption
premises.evidence_span: unethical businesses are eroding our trust in the concept of free

premises.text: Organizing collective knowledge of great versus catch-laden free products creates a safer discovery resource
premises.evidence_span: If we could take that information that we all know about the great products that are out there and the ones with the hidden catches

premises.text: Site supports instant safety checks and category browsing with structured comparison data
premises.evidence_span: fast and easy verification whether a free product is safe

premises.text: Business model sells profitable CPAs and inbound credits to freemium firms that are top user picks
premises.evidence_span: offer profitable CPAs to freemium businesses We're also going to give you credits for inbound people that you send to CatchFree

premises.text: Acquisition levers are reverse affiliate, viral loops, and search
premises.evidence_span: sharing and viral, that's on fire right now

value.text: Help people find the best free product for what they want to do, safely
value.evidence_span: find the best free app or service that does exactly what you want it to do

causal_links.evidence_span: missing out on some great apps and services

notes: Need/product/money triad present; justified because CPA packaging and viral/SEO growth are revisable independently of the trust thesis and the verification UX. Multi-billion freemium category size excluded as framing.
